parameters.description: Flags for the transfer. Some flags are specific to isochronous transfers. USB_START_ISOCH_ASAP starts transfer as soon as possible, instead of specifying a starting frame. USB_COMPRESS_ISOCH guarantees, for IN transfers, that data is copied contiguously to the user buffer, instead of being fragmented if the amount of data is less than the maximum requested for a particular frame. USB_COMPRESS_ISOCH only works if you do not specify a physical address. USB_NO_WAIT causes the function to act asynchronously. These flags shown in the following list are declared in the Usbtypes.h header file. USB_IN_TRANSFER USB_OUT_TRANSFER USB_NO_WAIT USB_SHORT_TRANSFER_OK USB_START_ISOCH_ASAP USB_COMPRESS_ISOCH
